title: Material Attributes
description: Defines the physical properties, armor protection, and hit sounds of materials, organized in three groups: physics / armor / sounds.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference path for editor intellisense and validation

physics.description: Physical properties: friction, slip, elasticity, etc.

friction.description: Friction coefficient vector [x, y, z]. x = lateral, y = forward, z = unused.

slip_adaptation.description: Slip adaptation coefficient, adjusts friction behavior during sliding.

kinetic_scale.description: Friction scale in high-slip kinetic region.

kinetic_angle_deg.description: Slip angle where kinetic plateau begins.

base_scale.description: Friction scale at zero slip angle.

kinetic_scale.description: Friction scale in high-angle kinetic region.

block_damage_factor.description: Block damage factor, 0 = cannot break blocks.

armor.description: Armor properties: penetration resistance, linear/percentage damage reduction, durability decay, and conditional modifiers. Pipeline: damage_modifiers -> (dmg - dmg_resist) * dmg_mult.

rha.description: Material penetration resistance coefficient relative to RHA (Rolled Homogeneous Armor).

angle_effect.description: Whether equivalent armor thickness is affected by impact angle.

dmg_resist.description: Global linear damage reduction. Final damage is reduced by this value (affected by durability decay).

dmg_mult.description: Global damage multiplier. Final damage is multiplied by this value (affected by durability decay). 0.95 = take 95% damage.

decay_rha.description: Residual RHA coefficient when durability reaches zero.

decay_dmg_resist.description: Residual linear reduction when durability reaches zero. Default 0.0 = completely gone.

decay_dmg_mult.description: Residual damage multiplier when durability reaches zero. Default 1.0 = fully ineffective.

decay_power.description: Armor degradation curve exponent. >1 = degrades slowly at first, then rapidly near failure (brittle); =1 = linear.

unpen_power.description: Damage exponent when attack fails to fully penetrate. Formula: dmg*(penetration/equivalent_armor)^unpen_power.

hit_un_pen.description: Sound event when hit box is hit but not penetrated.

hit_pen.description: Sound event when hit box is hit and penetrated.
